# Pine Country Landscape

> Pine Country Landscape LLC is a locally owned residential landscaping and yard care company in Flagstaff, Arizona. Owner and customer contact: Rowan Brandenberg. Phone or text: (928) 863-8198. Website: https://pinecountrylandscape.com

## Services

- Yard cleanups and pine needle and cone removal, with all debris hauled away
- Pruning and shrub shaping
- Mowing, first cut and recurring visits
- Weed control
- Debris hauling (dump trailer loads)
- Irrigation repair (leaks, heads, drip lines, zones)
- Sprinkler timer installs
- Sprinkler winterization and blowouts before the hard freeze
- Winter watering for trees and shrubs
- Tree and shrub planting and landscape design consultations
- Free plant doctor: photo diagnosis of struggling trees and shrubs
- Not offered this winter: snow removal (a waitlist is open for winter 2027 to 2028)

## Starting prices (typical Flagstaff lot)

- Yard cleanup: from $450
- Pruning and shrub shaping: from $295
- Mowing, first cut: from $350
- Mowing, recurring visit: from $170
- Weed control: from $150
- Debris haul, dump trailer load: from $295
- Irrigation repair: from $185 (includes the first hour)
- Timer install: from $295
- Sprinkler winterization blowout: from $165
- Winter watering visit: $95
- Tree and shrub diagnosis visit: $95
- Design consultation (90 minutes on site): $150, credited toward the project
- On site estimate: free
- Plant doctor photo diagnosis: free

Final prices depend on size and scope and are confirmed in writing before any work starts.

## How to get a price or book

- Instant price: send photos and a short description at https://pinecountrylandscape.com/#estimate and get a ballpark price by text and email, usually in under 10 minutes.
- Book online from the live calendar: https://pinecountrylandscape.com/#book
- Plant doctor: send photos of a sick tree or shrub at https://pinecountrylandscape.com/#plant-doctor and get an answer by text and email, usually within the hour.
- Text (928) 863-8198. Texting is fastest; calls go to voicemail during jobs and are returned the same day.

## Service area

Flagstaff, AZ and about 25 minutes out: Doney Park, Kachina Village, Mountainaire, Fort Valley, Continental, Cheshire, Timberline, Williams, Bellemont and Parks.

## Hours

Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, 8am to 5pm. Closed Tuesday and Thursday.

## Good to know

- Insured and bonded.
- Crew has worked Flagstaff yards for about four years.
- 4.8 average from 26 customer reviews shown on the website.
- Payment by card or cash.
